Welcome to Sri Sarguru

Where quality education meets compassion

Welcome to Sri Sarguru Matriculation School, where we nurture beautiful minds with love and care. Operated by the A.M. Muthuramaswamy Educational Trust, we began in 2000 with just five students and a simple belief — that love, knowledge and wisdom belong together in every classroom.

Today more than 500 children learn, play and grow with us, following the Tamil Nadu State Board syllabus from Pre-KG to 10th Standard, guided by caring teachers and a culture built on strong values.

Read Our Story
Our Differentiator

A university diploma in Computer Science — by Grade 9.

Through the SUITS programme — the School-University Industry-Tie-up Scheme, in association with Bharathidasan University, Tiruchirappalli — our students from Std 5 to Std 9 learn skill-based IT alongside their regular syllabus.

On completing Grade 9, each child earns a Diploma in Computer Science certification — a head start very few schools in the region can offer.

  • Structured IT learning, Std 5 to Std 9
  • In association with Bharathidasan University
  • Diploma in Computer Science by Grade 9
  • Hands-on practice in our Computer Science labs
Achievements

Success our students can hold in their hands

From Sri Sai Olympiads to talent-search examinations, our students take part — and excel — in competitions beyond the classroom, returning with medals and certificates that build lasting confidence.

Alongside a decade of 100% board results, these achievements reflect a culture where every child is encouraged to aim higher.

Values & social responsibility

As Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam believed, the purpose of education is to make good human beings with skill and expertise. We instil values and civic responsibility in our children from a young age.

Discipline & togetherness

Each day begins together on the ground — building discipline, unity and school spirit.

Citizens of tomorrow

National days, pledges and awareness drives shape responsible, patriotic young citizens.

Road Safety Patrol

Responsibility, worn with pride

Our Road Safety Patrol students help manage safe movement at the school gate — a small duty that teaches leadership, discipline and care for others.

Our Care & Approach

We teach with patience, and lead with care

Learning here isn't confined to textbooks. Whether it's examining a leaf under a tree or a quiet word of encouragement, our teachers guide each child with the patience and warmth that helps them grow into better citizens.

Small classes mean every child is known, supported and understood — the way good schooling should feel.

Beyond the Classroom

Culture, courage and character

Every child finds something of their own here — on the stage, on the ground, or in quiet practice.

Classical DanceMusicKarate SilambamVedic MathsAbacus Devaram & ThiruvasagamYoga

A values-first morning

Every school day begins with prayer and reflection.

Fit body, focused mind

Yoga, drills and Sports Day keep our children active and disciplined.
